描述_EN: many grave goods copied objects from daily life but in reduced size, such as this model of a granary. in the han dynasty (206bc-ad220) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware.
描述_ZN: 许多墓葬用品都是复制日常生活中的物品，但尺寸缩小了，比如这个粮仓的模型。 在汉代（公元前206年-公元220年），日常用具通常是由石器制成的，埋葬的物品是由陶器制成的。
